connector.name: Firma
connector.registryDescription: Local-first portfolio tracker for overseas investors. Claude reads and writes your finances via MCP.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package firma-app. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the evan-moon account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: FINNHUB_API_KEY
env.description: Finnhub API key for stock price sync and market data. Get a free key at finnhub.io. Alternatively set via: firma config set finnhub-key <key>
